findings.text: The task assumes the small fixture in `tests/test_judge_lock.py` can be extended to compare prediction derivation identities, but the fixture copies only `integrity/judge.nix`, `nix/`, `judge` and `conformance/corpus-v1`. The `predictions` attribute needs `build-support/default.nix` (the subject build), `belay` and `conformance`, and the spec also says not to copy the full checkout. Fix: say which extra paths the fixture must copy, or say that the identity test needs its own fixture that stubs `subject`.
